ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from moving the case back to a wrong queue.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), ISCHANGED( OwnerId ), (LEFT(OwnerId, 3) = "00G"), OR( AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Fraud_Check", Owner:Queue.DeveloperName <> "COB_Fraud_Check_Queue" ), AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "ID_Ops_Assistance", Owner:Queue.DeveloperName <> "COB_ID_Ops_Assistance_Queue" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You attempted to move the case back to a wrong queue, please move to correct queue.
